changes_vs_current: Margarita to #1 (4/4 sources), Mojito up to #2, Negroni drops from #4 to #5, Old Fashioned/Espresso Martini hold. Added: Amaretto Sour, Pornstar Martini, Penicillin, Boulevardier, White Russian, Caipirinha. Dropped: Gin and Tonic, French 75, Mint Julep, Tom Collins, Sazerac, Dark 'n' Stormy (French 75 just missed at 20.75; Gin and Tonic only in Ranker). Also shifted: Aperol Spritz #8 to #17, Piña Colada #10 to #21. Note: Nielsen CGA US on-premise 2024 sales (https://bevindustry.com/articles/97163-these-cocktails-stole-the-spotlight-in-us-on-premise) lists Margarita, Mojito, Espresso Martini, Negroni, Spritz as top 5 - read but excluded from the math (only 5 items); it supports the top of this list.
confidence: medium - 4 independent sources agree on the top ~8, but none is a US general-public poll of many cocktails: Drinks International is world-bar sales, Ranker snapshot is undated, Ice Maker Hub is search volume, Make Me a Cocktail is global app usage. Bartender-skewed picks (Penicillin, Boulevardier, Pornstar Martini at 18-20) come from Drinks International alone and may feel unfamiliar to casual US players; short source lists (10/20) inflate the missing-item penalty for mid-ranked items. Ranker's live page was blocked (HTTP 401).
